title: The Beacons of Orport
logline: On storm-lashed, eerie Orport, you set out to recover the lantern cores and restore the Old Lighthouse.
source_prompt: A haunted lighthouse on a stormy island at night
player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Harbour Village and becomes the one who brings the Old Lighthouse back to life.

key_locations.name: Harbour Village
key_locations.description: The start: the fishing village and its quay.

key_locations.name: Sea Cave
key_locations.description: Sea Cave: a cave of Orport, reached by the trail from Harbour Village.

key_locations.name: Sunken Ruins
key_locations.description: Sunken Ruins: a ruin of Orport, reached by the trail from Harbour Village.

key_locations.name: Gull Peak
key_locations.description: Gull Peak: a summit of Orport, reached by the trail from Harbour Village.

key_locations.name: Old Lighthouse
key_locations.description: The old lighthouse at the heart of the story, standing beyond Harbour Village.

characters.name: Keeper Maren
characters.description: Waits in Harbour Village and knows why the Old Lighthouse fell silent.

characters.name: Nadia the Deckhand
characters.description: Follows you from Harbour Village and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Reef Crab
characters.description: A crab the size of a cart, snapping at anyone near the rocks. Keep your distance.

characters.name: Odo the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Orport for anything shiny.

objectives_outline: Speak with Keeper Maren in Harbour Village
Recover the lantern cores hidden across Sea Cave, Sunken Ruins, Gull Peak
hazards: Storm sweeping the exposed ground around the Old Lighthouse
